verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own docs state the H200 operates 'within the same power profile as the H100' (nvidia-h200-sxm-docs-4), but this is a vendor claim only — no independent performance-per-watt benchmarks or third-party power-envelope testing are present in the evidence pack. Community notes (nvidia-h200-sxm-comm-2) even highlight that H200 shares H100 silicon, which is consistent but not an efficiency benchmark. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on power-draw measurements under sustained load, third-party perf/watt comparisons, and detailed thermal/power documentation beyond the single marketing sentence.
